ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) with localized high-intensity (white) regions on distal tips; approximate pixel area ratio of 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke areas consist of a contiguous dark mass. Distal lobes exhibit high-contrast white geometric blobs. The left distal tip contains a white triangular patch with internal dark striations. The right distal tip features a larger, irregular white patch with dense internal dark mottling/speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serration along the trailing edge. Pixel amplitude increases significantly at the lateral tips where irregular jaggedness is present.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve sweeping symmetrically from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, brownish-orange raised pixel groups localized along the extreme lateral edges and tips, consistent with localized surface colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, faint light-intensity linear pixel streaks (approx. 5-10 pixels in width) detected horizontally across the dark central and right-medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and small V-shaped indentations along the trailing edge indicative of historical tissue wear or interaction marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-orange pigmentation clusters concentrated on the leading and trailing margins of the outermost lobe tips.
